mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_login_events (event_type, method, outcome, username, user_id, reason, ip, user_agent) VALUES (#{eventType}, #{method}, #{outcome}, #{username}, #{userId}, #{reason}, #{ip}, #{userAgent})
mapper.select: SELECT id::text AS id, event_type, method, outcome, username, user_id, reason, ip, user_agent, occurred_at, count(*) OVER()::integer AS total FROM auth_login_events WHERE (#{eventType}::text IS NULL OR event_type = #{eventType}) AND (#{outcome}::text IS NULL OR outcome = #{outcome}) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT count(*)::integer FROM auth_login_events WHERE event_type = 'login' AND method = 'password' AND outcome = 'failure' AND occurred_at >= #{since} AND ( (#{username}::text IS NOT NULL AND lower(username) = lower(#{username})) OR (#{ip}::text IS NOT NULL AND ip = #{ip}) )
